capabilities: block double tap from opening the editor in Reading view
configure double tap action (nothing, select word, or switch to editing)
preserve single taps on links and checkboxes and scroll drags
shorten the double tap interval with a Pro setting
extras: Freemium: the shorter double tap interval is Pro, unlocked by a $15 one-time or $5 monthly GitHub Sponsors sponsorship with GitHub device-flow sign-in. Tests run only in the desktop app with mobile emulation, not on real iOS or Android devices. After minor or major updates it opens a What's new tab that suggests other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat (can be turned off in settings).
motivation: Accidental double taps on a moving bus or with a shaky hand opened the editor and let the keyboard type into the note.
problem: In Obsidian, two quick taps in Reading view on mobile open the editor by accident, and the keyboard can then type into the note; CSS and hiding the edit button cannot prevent it.
summary: Reading view guard that stops a double tap on phone or tablet from switching the note to editing, with a setting for what a double tap does instead.
